subject.title: feat(plugins): add exact-profile provider usage reads

question: Should OpenClaw make exact-profile, token-free provider usage reads a supported plugin SDK capability for trusted plugins?
rationale: The patch is additive and credential-adjacent: deciding whether plugins should receive this data, and what compatibility and authorization promise the API carries, is a product and security-boundary choice rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Sponsor the scoped SDK API
options.body: Approve this as the supported trusted-plugin seam, then require redacted real-provider proof and retain the documented no-refresh and no-fallback guarantees.

options.title: Keep quota reads owner-specific
options.body: Decline the general SDK method and move any needed quota behavior into the owning provider or plugin until a broader API direction is approved.

options.title: Defer the contract
options.body: Pause this PR while maintainers define the allowed plugin audience and compatibility expectations for exact-profile usage data.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the scoped SDK API
recommendation.body: Approve this as the supported trusted-plugin seam, then require redacted real-provider proof and retain the documented no-refresh and no-fallback guarantees.

likelyOwner.reason: A historical owner should decide whether this becomes a durable public plugin-runtime contract.
